capabilities: size image embeds with percent, em, rem, vw and vh units in the embed link
keep pixel-sized images drawn exactly as Obsidian draws them
read Pandoc width and height attribute blocks placed after an image link
set a default size for images without a size, per note via a property (Pro)
extras: Freemium: relative units and Pandoc attributes are free; default image sizes need a paid Pro sign-in. After updates it opens a 'What's new' tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. Pro checks run through the GitHub device flow; the token is stored via Obsidian's secret storage API.
intentEvidence: lets you size an embedded image with percent, em, rem, vw and vh, in the link that you already write
motivation: The author built it to answer a forum request asking Obsidian to allow relative units, not just pixels, in image resize.
problem: Obsidian only reads a pixel number in an image embed, so a width that fits a laptop screen is too wide on a phone and cannot scale with the text column.

relations.evidence: a Pandoc attribute block such as {width=50%} after the link

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($15 once or $5/month)

summary: Sizes embedded images with relative units (percent, em, rem, vw, vh) written directly in the embed link, in Live Preview and Reading view.
